		limit = { title:h_china = { is_title_localization_key_used = dynn_title_zhou } }
		scope:rmtm_restoration_hegemony_title = {
			set_title_name = rmtm_later_dynn_title_zhou
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { title:h_china = { is_title_localization_key_used = dynn_title_zhuang_li } }
		scope:rmtm_restoration_hegemony_title = {
			set_title_name = rmtm_later_dynn_title_zhuang_li
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { title:h_china = { is_title_localization_key_used = dynn_title_zou } }
		scope:rmtm_restoration_hegemony_title = {
			set_title_name = rmtm_later_dynn_title_zou
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Preserve a literal player-authored title name when no pinned vanilla key matches.
		title:h_china = {
			move_title_name_to = scope:rmtm_restoration_hegemony_title
		}
		# A literal player-authored name has no finite localization-key alias.
		# CK3's native prefix field is the only lossless dynamic representation.
		scope:rmtm_restoration_hegemony_title = {
			set_title_prefix = rmtm_restoration_title_prefix
		}
	}
	title:h_china = { reset_title_name = yes }
}
